name: Andres Gomez-Emilsson
abstract_title: Indra’s Net via Nonlinear Optics: DMT Phenomenology, Beam-Splitter Holography, and the One-and-Many Structure of Experience
abstract: This paper develops a concrete implementation sketch of the "brain as a nonlinear optical computer" (BaaNLOC) and argues that it can naturally explain two otherwise puzzling properties of exotic states of consciousness: (1) the sense of autonomous entities on N,N-DMT (Strassman, 2001) and (2) "Indra's Net" states in which "everything explicitly reflects everything else."
